data.title: Ore Processing and Haulage Plant
data.summary: The fixed plant between a mine and a railhead: crushing, a modular conveying system, milling and separation, storage and rail loadout, tailings, water and site services.
data.description: Original CC0 heavy mineral processing plant. Every elevated conveyor, bin and vessel stands on braced lattice steelwork with grating walkways, handrails and toe boards, stair towers and flanged transfer chutes, and every head pulley carries a real drive unit. Conveyor modules share a belt connector contract: belt-a and belt-b at a 2.40 m belt line on a 12 m pitch, so straights, inclines, curves and galleries chain through transfer towers. The plant starts at the truck dump pocket and ends at the rail loadout bin; there is no pit, no mining fleet and nothing underground.

starterScene.title: Ore plant overview, crusher to loadout (Ore Processing and Haulage Plant)
starterScene.summary: The plant spine in flow order: the truck dump pocket with its pedestal rock breaker feeding a vibrating grizzly feeder and the primary jaw crusher, an apron feeder onto the conveyor tail station, two straight overland modules, the 44 m inclined flight climbing to a transfer...
starterScene.description: The plant spine in flow order: the truck dump pocket with its pedestal rock breaker feeding a vibrating grizzly feeder and the primary jaw crusher, an apron feeder onto the conveyor tail station, two straight overland modules, the 44 m inclined flight climbing to a transfer tower, and a level gallery and a rising gallery carrying the line across to the product silos and the rail loadout bin. The screening and secondary crushing bay stands beside the flight, with the weighbridge, truck loadout, switchroom, workshop, assay laboratory, site office and fuel island along the access road.

assets.summary: Independent test rows proving the belt connector contract. Row one runs a tail station through a straight module, a 30 degree horizontal curve and a second straight into a head station at grade. Row two climbs from a tail station through a straight and an inclined module...
assets.description: Independent test rows proving the belt connector contract. Row one runs a tail station through a straight module, a 30 degree horizontal curve and a second straight into a head station at grade. Row two climbs from a tail station through a straight and an inclined module, then a 44 m inclined flight into a transfer tower, out through a level gallery, a rising gallery and a second transfer tower, and away on a third gallery. Row three feeds a radial stacker from the belt line and carries the reclaim tunnel belt into a gallery bridge.
